# Psalm 125 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-song of-the-ascents. Those-trusting in-YHWH like-mount Zion; not it-is-moved, to-forever it-sits.

**2** Jerusalem — mountains around-her, and-YHWH around his-people, from-now and-to forever.

**3** For not will-rest the-scepter-of wickedness on the-lot-of the-righteous, so-that not put-forth the-righteous to-unrighteousness their-hands.

**4** Do-good O-YHWH to-the-good, and-to-the-upright in-their-hearts.

**5** And-those-turning-aside to-their-crooked-ways, will-lead-them-away YHWH with doers-of iniquity. Peace upon Israel.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **125:2**: 'Mountains around-her, and-YHWH around his-people' — the physical geography of Jerusalem (surrounded by hills) becomes a metaphor for divine protection.

— EMET
